title: 4/29-30 bpm promoted to FEATURE_COLS but never built in the inference path: every scheduler prediction crashed; the 4/30 pick sat unlocked and unposted until the fix
tier_reason: liveness failure of the live prediction path for about 19 hours (every tick crashed), and the 4/30 pick was neither locked nor posted as of the fix (delivery at risk)

contract.text: Every feature in FEATURE_COLS is populated in the live inference rows, so each scheduler lineup check produces predictions and a lockable pick before the earliest pick game's first pitch.
contract.source: commit ee4190f message body; commit 7afee63 message body (FEATURE_COLS extended 15 -> 16)

mechanism.text: 7afee63 added batter_pitcher_shrunk_hr to FEATURE_COLS and to compute_all_features, but predict() builds inference rows from the _build_feature_lookups dicts, which never carried bpm, so every live prediction raised KeyError "['batter_pitcher_shrunk_hr'] not in index"

predict_local caught the exception and returned None and run_single_check returned without a pick; the scheduler read missed_pick_alert_min ('Alert threshold ... if no pick posted') but never acted on it (the E3 alert was dead config until bb7ccc1), so no alert fired while the 3 AM projected preview pick stayed on disk unlocked and unposted

residual.text: The fix commit added no alert; the delivery symptom became alertable only when the E3 missed-pick alert was implemented on 6/10 (bb7ccc1, 'was dead config'), and its state.pick_locked gate still let a classification-locked undelivered day pass silently until 224ddce (8/14, I-083).
residual.source: commit bb7ccc1 message body; commit 224ddce; working table E59, E83

watchdog.trigger: two consecutive scheduled lineup checks end with 'Prediction failed' (no predictions), or the earliest pick game's first pitch minus 5 min approaches with the day's pick still unlocked and undelivered
watchdog.recovery_assertion: the next lineup check produces predictions and the day ends with a delivered pick or a recorded deliberate skip

evidence.what: every scheduler tick after the 4/29 deploy crashed with "['batter_pitcher_shrunk_hr'] not in index"; the 3 AM cron's pick file carried projected-lineup picks forward unchanged, never locked, never posted to Bluesky
